def flop_count(model: nn.Module, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...], supported_ops:
    Optional[Dict[str, Handle]]=None) ->Tuple[DefaultDict[str, float],
    Counter[str]]:
    analysis = FlopCountAnalysis(model, inputs)
    if supported_ops is not None:
        analysis.set_op_handle(**supported_ops)
    return analysis.by_operator(), analysis.get_unsupported_ops()
